{{Infobox place|name=The Shards|type=Island chain|region=South of [[the Banner-lands]]|house=[[House Tidebreaker]]|notable=Ten plain islands — and one barely visible in the fog, "seen twice, found never"}}
'''The Shards''' are a scattered island chain off the southern coast, home to their own maritime culture and half-independent of the mainland. [[House Tidebreaker]] keeps its seat, [[the Wave-Reader]], on the outermost island facing [[the Sleeping Sea]].

[[Plate I]] draws ten plain islands — and an eleventh, barely visible in the fog, that sailors say has been ''"seen twice, found never."'' The charts never agree.
